characters.summary: Cotterpin Doozer is a young, creative and stubborn Doozer who prefers art to pure work; she rejected the helmet, briefly ran away to become a Fraggle, and was allowed to take the drawing board as an architect apprentice.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

weaknesses: Tiny Doozer size relative to Fraggles
limitations: No combat role; her documented interests are art and design

sources.supports: Cotterpin: young female Doozer, most frequently seen Doozer; passions are art and 'fun' rather than pure work; creative but stubborn and rebellious; rejected the helmet and ran away to become a Fraggle; Architect Doozer let her take the drawing board; in 'The Trial of Cotterpin Doozer' she had to prove Fraggles were noble and intelligent or lose her apprenticeship.

feats.claim: Won the drawing board (architect apprenticeship) instead of the work helmet, and defended it in 'The Trial of Cotterpin Doozer'.

unknowns: Combat utility against full-sized opponents is not established.
The source does not describe her building or inventing anything specific, so the inventor tag was removed.

characters.summary: Crazy Harry is The Muppet Show's pyrotechnic expert, who delights in blowing things up and turns up at any explosive-sounding word asking "Did somebody say bang?".
limitations: Explosions need set-up; no other combat skill is documented

sources.supports: Crazy Harry: 'the pyrotechnic expert on The Muppet Show'; 'delights in blowing things up'; asks 'Did somebody say bang?' before an explosion; played the explodaphone with Jean Stapleton (episode 306); in The Muppets uses explosives to carve his head into Mount Rushmore; sets off explosions in Muppets Most Wanted.

Muppet explosions: Crazy Harry sets off explosions in many productions; in Muppet Show: Sex and Violence he 'sets off an explosion when the Seven Deadly Sins are about to attack Nigel'; in episode 522 he answers a request for a bigger candle with 'a big stick of TNT'; several explosions throw the guest star onto the rafters.

feats.claim: Used explosives to carve his own head into Mount Rushmore.
Set off an explosion as the Seven Deadly Sins were about to attack Nigel.
feats.citation: The Muppet Show: Sex and Violence

unknowns: Whether he is hurt by his own explosions is not stated.
fire-weapon removed: explosions are not fire use (same reasoning as the Sabine Wren fire ruling). Whether explosives should earn tech, as Sabine's explosives do, is left to the owner.

characters.summary: Doc is Fraggle Rock's inventor and only regular human character; he lives with his dog Sprocket in a workshop whose wall-hole leads to the Fraggles' caves.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

limitations: Ordinary human with no combat training documented

sources.supports: Doc: inventor and only regular human character in Fraggle Rock; lives with Sprocket; inventions include the Rocket Sprocket and the Collapsible Bookcase; named Man of the Year by the North American Society of Tinkerers; friendship/rivalry with neighbour Ned Shimmelfinney; learns of Gobo late in the series ('The Honk of Honks').

feats.claim: Invented the Rocket Sprocket and the Collapsible Bookcase, and was named Man of the Year by the North American Society of Tinkerers.

campaignTags.claim: Inventor of the Rocket Sprocket and Collapsible Bookcase; Man of the Year of the North American Society of Tinkerers.

unknowns: gadgets removed: the source shows no device used in a conflict.

characters.summary: Dr. Bunsen Honeydew is The Muppet Show's resident scientist and host of Muppet Labs, whose eager, short-sighted inventions usually end up harming his assistant Beaker.

techniques: Muppet Labs inventions (e.g. Insta-Grow Pills, exploding clothes)

weaknesses: Short-sighted; his inventions usually harm Beaker
limitations: Relies on his inventions; no personal combat skill documented

sources.supports: Bunsen: resident scientist on The Muppet Show and host of Muppet Labs; inventions include a gorilla detector, exploding clothes, edible paper clips, a banana sharpener, hair-growing tonic, a gold-to-cottage-cheese machine and Insta-Grow Pills, which temporarily make things grow bigger; 'Beaker usually ends up being harmed by Dr. Honeydew's inventions'.

feats.claim: Invented the gorilla detector, exploding clothes, edible paper clips and Insta-Grow Pills (which temporarily make things bigger).

campaignTags.claim: Muppet Labs head scientist with many documented inventions.
Deploys his inventions, e.g. Insta-Grow Pills and exploding clothes.

unknowns: Combat effectiveness without prep time or laboratory equipment.
No ray guns, shrinking devices or matter transmitters are documented in the source.

characters.summary: Dr. Julius Strangepork is the elderly resident scientist aboard the Swinetrek in "Pigs in Space": he does repairs and diagnostics, is the only one who knows how the whole ship works, and invents questionably useful devices.
limitations: No combat, piloting or weapon use documented

sources.supports: Strangepork: 'resident scientist aboard the Swinetrek spaceship' with Captain Link Hogthrob and First Mate Piggy; performs routine repair work and diagnostics; episode 218 reveals he is 'the only one who knows how all of the Swinetrek works'; invented 'questionably useful devices' including the Dissolvatron and invisibility pills.

feats.claim: The only crew member who knows how all of the Swinetrek works.
feats.citation: The Muppet Show episode 218 (Pigs in Space)

feats.claim: Invented the Dissolvatron and invisibility pills.

campaignTags.claim: Invented the Dissolvatron and invisibility pills.

unknowns: pilot removed: the source does not show him flying the Swinetrek.
Whether he or anyone used the invisibility pills, and with what effect.

characters.summary: Dr. Teeth is the gold-toothed leader, lead singer and keyboardist of the Electric Mayhem, the house band on The Muppet Show, and (per The Muppets Mayhem) an accredited dentist.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

sources.supports: Dr. Teeth: leader of the Electric Mayhem, the house band on The Muppet Show; lead singer and keyboardist; one gold tooth; The Muppets Mayhem episode 6 reveals he is an accredited dentist; very long arms; no fights or feats described.

feats.claim: Leads the Electric Mayhem as lead singer and keyboardist.

unknowns: Actual combat record against trained combatants.

characters.summary: Elmo is a self-described three-and-a-half-year-old red monster on Sesame Street: enthusiastic, friendly and cheerful, and devoted to his blanket.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

limitations: Very young (3 1/2) with no combat feats documented

sources.supports: Elmo: 'self-described as three-and-a-half years old'; 'Enthusiastic, friendly and cheerful'; loves riding his tricycle and being tickled; devoted to his blue blanket, Blanket, in The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland; no physical feats listed.

Plot: Elmo follows Blanket through a tunnel into Grouchland; is jailed; convinces the Humongous Chicken that he is not a worm; confronts Huxley, who has taken Blanket; Bug takes the blanket and gives it back to Elmo, breaking off his friendship with Huxley.

feats.claim: Talked the Humongous Chicken out of eating him by convincing it he was not a worm.
feats.citation: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland (1999)

feats.claim: Followed his blanket into Grouchland and confronted Huxley to get it back.
feats.citation: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland (1999)

unknowns: Against Huxley, Blanket came back through Bug, not by Elmo defeating Huxley, so no win is recorded.

characters.summary: Emmet Otter is the protagonist of Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas: a poor young otter who does odd jobs with his late Pa's tools and plays washtub bass in the Frogtown Hollow Jubilee Jug Band.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

limitations: No combat training or aggressive instincts documented

sources.supports: Emmet: protagonist of Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas; plays washtub bass in the Frogtown Hollow Jubilee Jug Band; does odd jobs using Pa Otter's old tool box; the band is later hired for a permanent gig at the Riverside Rest.

Emmet drills a hole in the bottom of Ma's washtub to turn it into a bass; he does odd jobs around town; he and Ma row down the river and slide down Pa's slide on the icy bank; the Riverbottom Nightmare Band wins the talent show; no swimming is described.

feats.claim: Drilled a hole in Ma's washtub to turn it into a bass for the talent contest.

unknowns: Combat capabilities outside peaceful musical contexts.
swimmer and water-breathing removed: no swimming is documented in the sources opened, and otters do not breathe water.
